description: This file defines utility functions, classes, and constants related to media service permissions and package management in Android. It includes functions for UID checks, permission validation, and package info retrieval, as well as classes for managing package permissions and caching UID info.

classes.name: MediaPackageManager
classes.description: Manages package permission checks for playback capture and provides dump functionality.

classes.name: UidInfo
classes.description: Caches and retrieves package information for UIDs, including package name, installer, version, and expiration.

methods.name: allowPlaybackCapture
methods.description: Checks if a UID is allowed to capture playback based on package permissions.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the internal state of MediaPackageManager for debugging.

methods.name: doIsAllowed
methods.description: Internal method to determine if a UID is permitted for playback capture.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns cached package info for a UID, refetching if expired.
